titleEn: Maximum Product of Splitted Binary Tree
title: 分裂二叉树的最大乘积
summary: 删除二叉树一条边得到两棵子树，求两部分节点和乘积最大值并对 10^9+7 取模。
insight: 先求整树总和；第二次后序遍历得到每个子树和 sub，删除其父边后的乘积就是 sub·(total-sub)，对所有非根子树取最大即可。
pitfalls: 比较最大值前不能先取模
子树和与乘积用长整型
根对应整树乘积为零，不影响最大值

solutions.title: 总和与子树和双遍历
solutions.idea: 枚举每条父子边对应的子树分割。
steps: 第一次 sum(root) 得 total
第二次 dfs 后序计算 sub=val+left+right，并用 sub*(total-sub) 更新 maximum

code.java: class Solution { private long total,maximum;public int maxProduct(TreeNode root){total=sum(root);sumAndProduct(root);return (int)(maximum%1000000007L);}private long sum(TreeNode node){return node==null?0:node.val+sum(node.left)+sum(node.right);}private long sumAndProduct(TreeNode node){if(node==null)return 0;long sub=node.val+sumAndProduct(node.left)+sumAndProduct(node.right);maximum=Math.max(maximum,sub*(total-sub));return sub;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private var total=0L;private var maximum=0L;fun maxProduct(root:TreeNode?):Int{total=sum(root);sumAndProduct(root);return (maximum%1000000007L).toInt()};private fun sum(node:TreeNode?):Long=node?.let{it.`val`+sum(it.left)+sum(it.right)}?:0L;private fun sumAndProduct(node:TreeNode?):Long{node?:return 0;val sub=node.`val`+sumAndProduct(node.left)+sumAndProduct(node.right);maximum=maxOf(maximum,sub*(total-sub));return sub} }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long total=0,maximum=0;long long sum(TreeNode* node){return node?node->val+sum(node->left)+sum(node->right):0;}long long sumAndProduct(TreeNode* node){if(!node)return 0;long long sub=node->val+sumAndProduct(node->left)+sumAndProduct(node->right);maximum=max(maximum,sub*(total-sub));return sub;}public:int maxProduct(TreeNode* root){total=sum(root);sumAndProduct(root);return maximum%1000000007;} };
